summary: Verified new Auto Investigation feature end-to-end. All 12 auto_investigate pytest tests pass locally, plus 32 existing cyberlab regression tests pass. Public URL API responses correct for all 8 malware sample fixtures (PS -EncodedCommand, mshta, certutil, rundll32-HTA, Office macro, ransomware, nested b64+gzip, Sysmon XML). Frontend Auto Investigate CTA renders as primary; live 5-stage progress panel transitions pending→running→ok correctly for both payload path (detect→auto-decode→analyze→ai→render) and log path (detect→parse-log→analyze→ai→render). AI stage completes ~20-27s with Sigma/YARA/SPL rules. Verdict banner, Recipe, Output, MITRE/Rules/IOCs/Chain/Graph tabs, and Process Tree viewer all populate. Log path correctly defaults graph mode to Process Tree. Manual Auto Decode + Run Recipe secondary buttons coexist. Empty input returns HTTP 400.

issues: Verdict text renders 'Suspicious Suspicious' / 'Clean Clean' — the label ('Suspicious') appears twice back-to-back (once in badge, once in description) with no separator space. Cosmetic only.
Console warning: 'It looks like you’ve created a new nodeTypes or edgeTypes object.' Recommend memoizing nodeTypes/edgeTypes outside the render or via useMemo to prevent re-renders.

action_items: (Cosmetic) De-duplicate verdict label rendering in verdict-banner ('Suspicious Suspicious' → 'Suspicious').
(Perf) Memoize React Flow nodeTypes/edgeTypes to silence warnings and avoid unnecessary re-renders.
critical_code_review_comments: Auto-investigate response nests MITRE/IOCs/risk/verdict under 'analysis' key rather than top-level. The pytest tests handle this correctly, but any external API consumers must be aware. Consider documenting the response schema.

AI stage duration is 20-27s on public URL — acceptable but frontend should keep the graceful failure UX in case of Emergent LLM timeouts. Confirmed AI stage 'failed' status handling exists per component code.
Router file /app/backend/cyberlab/router.py is growing large; consider splitting orchestrator into its own module if further stages are added.
